verdict.rationale: logo-design-skill is an Agent Skill: a folder containing a SKILL.md plus local Python scripts that an agent loads and runs inside its own session. It has no hosted service and no separate product UI that an API could mirror, so 'API parity with the UI' is a wrong-axis question for this kind of product. The local gallery and command-line search are dev-side tooling, not a UI/API product surface.
